'''Kelp''' was a type of [[Seaweed/Legends|seaweed]] found in the oceans of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Since the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was a [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]], the only food sources of food were [[Tarisian kelp]] and marine animals. Most kelp died just prior to the [[Tarisian Civil War]] due to poisoning from industrialists.

The ancestors of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] learned to develop aquaculture systems, including keeping [[Fish/Legends|fish]] in pens and the cultivation of kelp.<ref name="SWS" />
